connector.name: Feishu User Plugin by EthanQC
connector.registryDescription: Feishu/Lark MCP server + CLI tool. 85 tools, 3 auth layers. Send as user via cookie+protobuf.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package feishu-user-plugin. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ethanqc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: LARK_COOKIE
env.description: Feishu web session cookie. Required for user-identity messaging tools (send_to_user, send_as_user, etc).

env.name: LARK_APP_ID
env.description: Feishu Open Platform self-built app App ID (cli_xxxxxxxxxxxx). Required for Official API tools (docs, bitable, wiki, drive, calendar, tasks, OKR, group messaging).

env.name: LARK_APP_SECRET
env.description: Feishu Open Platform self-built app App Secret. Used together with LARK_APP_ID.

env.name: LARK_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: User OAuth UAT for P2P chat reading and as user-owner on resource creation. Obtained via 'npx feishu-user-plugin oauth'.
